source_title: Uttarakhand CM Pushkar Singh Dhami meets public, asks officials to address grievances without delay - The Times of India
source_excerpt: DEHRADUN: Uttarakhand chief minister Pushkar Singh Dhami on Sunday met members of the public and local representatives at his private residence in Nagla Tarai and at the Lohiahead Helipad in Khatima to hear their grievances. He directed officials to ensure their prompt, transparent and effective resolution.Dhami emphasised that time-bound redressal of public grievances remains a top priority for the state government. He instructed officials to work with sensitivity and urgency to ensure that people do not have to make unnecessary visits to government offices to get their issues addressed.Highlighting the state government's mantra of âSimplification, Resolution, and Satisfactionâ, the chief minister stressed the need for administrative accountability and satisfactory solutions to people's problems.During the interactions, Dhami also discussed ongoing regional development projects and local requirements with public representatives. He reiterated the government's commitment to carrying out development works in line with public expectations and strengthening civic amenities.Earlier on Friday, Dhami called for collective efforts to combat drug abuse, emphasising the need to involve every young person, student and child in the campaign to build a healthy and drug-free Uttarakhand.Addressing the 'Drug-Free Uttarakhand' Walkathon at ONGC's Dr B. R. Ambedkar Ground in Dehradun, Dhami said the initiative aimed to spread awareness about the dangers of drug abuse and take the message to every household.The chief minister said, "Through this walkathon, we are strengthening our resolve to build a healthy and drug-free Uttarakhand. We must take this message to every household and involve every young person, student and child in this campaign, spreading the message of 'Say no to drugs, and yes to life."Describing the walkathon as more than a regular event, Dhami commended the efforts of those working to turn the issue of drug abuse, particularly its impact on the younger generation, into a wider social movement.âThis event that is happening, in which you all are going to run, is not just a regular event. Instead, it is a public awareness campaign and a social movement. And for this wonderful initiative, for this vision, many people work hard. You all have made a very commendable effort in the direction of turning this important topic related to society and the future of the youth into a mass movement.
